name: SALT
long_description: Salt is a neo banking solution stitched together to ease payments and documentation which comes with business banking by moving it to a digital-first and automated end to end platform.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Graduated from IIT Kharagpur and holds a bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering and further pursued a Bachelor of Laws. 
Previously co-founded LetsTransport. This techno logistics platform has raised over 35m USD in the past. He has been recognized by both Forbes Asia & India 30 under 30

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Dynamic co-founder with 3+ years of experience in fintech, product development, growth, and brand strategy. Y Combinator W22 alum and Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree with a proven track record of scaling early-stage companies, raising $2M+ in venture funding, and driving 20%+ early MoM growth with 98% retention. Skilled in leading cross-functional teams, building high-performing organisations, and executing data-driven GTM and engagement strategies. Built a personal audience of 200,000+ across social
